Engineer. Programmer. Founder.

I build things.

Formula One R&D. Thirteen years co-founding a B2B SaaS company, scaling it to £8M ARR and 40 staff, and selling it. An MSc in AI with Distinction. Now a staff engineer working on warehouse robotics.

And a robot arm, a spiral staircase, a drift trike, a wall-sized bookcase, a CV in a cardboard box, and a house with curved walls that needed its skirting board steam-bent.
